description: Defines the class 'unique_rx_buffer' which manages locking and unlocking of a receive buffer in a thread-safe manner, including resource management and scope-based locking.

classes.name: unique_rx_buffer
classes.description: A class that wraps a receive buffer instance, providing thread-safe locking, unlocking, and resource management within a scope.

classes.name: callback
classes.description: An inner class of 'unique_rx_buffer' that provides an interface for locking, unlocking, and releasing the buffer, inheriting from 'rx_buffer'.

methods.name: unique_rx_buffer()
methods.description: Default constructor creating an invalid buffer.

methods.name: explicit unique_rx_buffer(callback& instance_)
methods.description: Constructs a unique buffer from a callback instance, attempting to lock it.

methods.name: ~unique_rx_buffer()
methods.description: Destructor that unlocks the buffer if valid.

methods.name: unique_rx_buffer(unique_rx_buffer&)
methods.description: Deleted copy constructor to prevent sharing.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Returns a reference to the underlying rx_buffer, asserting validity.

methods.name: get() const
methods.description: Returns a const reference to the underlying rx_buffer, asserting validity.

methods.name: operator*()
methods.description: Dereference operator returning the buffer reference.

methods.name: operator->()
methods.description: Arrow operator returning pointer to buffer.

methods.name: is_valid() const
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is valid (not nullptr).

methods.name: release()
methods.description: Releases the buffer resources and invalidates the pointer.

methods.name: unlock()
methods.description: Unlocks the buffer resources and invalidates the pointer.
